paraphrase: Cohort membership follows a student through Arizona public education. Responsibility stays with the last school and LEA, including non-graduates not enrolled there in graduation year, subject to specified transfer and departure exceptions. The graduation-recording school and LEA become the last school of record. Four-year outcomes end August 31 of the cohort year. Accountability FY2025 reports four-year cohort2024; five-year outcomes use a different deadline. Exit codes assign graduate, non-graduate, or exited-cohort status. Only integrity-passing records enter calculation.
